title: Phase 1: establish reproducible Gradle core gate and modernization baseline
what_changed: Made the core build repeatable by adding a pinned Gradle wrapper, dependency verification, lockfiles, real test discovery, publication checks, and a software bill of materials.
why_it_mattered: A future change could now be judged against a reproducible baseline instead of a machine-specific build.
verified_outcome: Recorded 832 Gradle tests, 1,075 Ant tests, strict dependency verification, publication checks, and mutation detection.

title: Phase 2: JDK 21 runtime modernization and reproducible build stabilization
what_changed: Moved the Gradle modules and runtime path to JDK 21, replaced unsupported JDK internals, and added database, desktop, scheduler, installer, LDAP, and Tomcat compatibility checks.
why_it_mattered: This removed the main runtime-age blocker while proving that core login, processing, scheduling, and database behavior still worked.
verified_outcome: Recorded 863 Gradle tests, 1,387 Ant tests, PostgreSQL restore/migration, Swing login/menu/process, scheduler, and Tomcat 9 smoke evidence.

title: Phase 3 installed distribution: guardrails, metadata validation, and install smoke
what_changed: Created a guarded full-product build and install lifecycle with disposable database protection, metadata validation, installer checks, and installed-product smoke coverage.
why_it_mattered: The project moved from compiling libraries to proving that a complete ADempiere distribution could be assembled and started safely.
verified_outcome: Installed-distribution and metadata gates became the foundation for later API and web runtime tests.

title: Phase 4 API edge modernization: XFire-free web-service seam and contract evidence
what_changed: Captured the existing SOAP contracts and introduced an XFire-free service seam and test evidence without yet removing the legacy runtime.
why_it_mattered: Freezing the external API behavior made it possible to replace obsolete technology without asking integrations to change unexpectedly.
verified_outcome: WSDL, HTTP, routing, and round-trip evidence established the migration oracle.

title: Phase 4 API edge modernization completion
what_changed: Completed the SOAP replacement with a CXF/Jakarta runtime, compatibility routing, installed-product packaging, security scenarios, and removal of active XFire assets.
why_it_mattered: Customers and integrations could keep the established SOAP contract while the unsupported implementation underneath it was replaced.
verified_outcome: The modern runtime replayed 33 operation baselines and security/mutation scenarios through the installed product.

title: Phase 5a: establish web inventory and Jakarta target
what_changed: Inventoried ZK source, web assets, namespaces, descriptors, and routes, then selected checksum-pinned ZK CE 10.3.0.1-jakarta as the target.
why_it_mattered: The web migration gained a complete map and a legally usable public target instead of relying on a risky blanket namespace rewrite.
verified_outcome: Database-neutral inventory and target verification passed while runtime behavior remained unchanged.

title: Phase 5b: freeze the legacy Tomcat 9 web oracle and pin legacy web artifacts
what_changed: Froze the legacy Tomcat 9/ZK 3.6 web behavior and deployable artifacts as a rollback and comparison oracle.
why_it_mattered: Once the old web framework changed, this evidence preserved the answer to 'what did the application do before?' for login, menu, sessions, routes, and packaging.
verified_outcome: The oracle covered six WARs, the login/role/menu/logout flow, 82 reviewed request vectors, exclusions, digests, and pinned runtime coordinates.

title: Phase 5c: add Jakarta web packaging beachhead
what_changed: Added an isolated Jakarta packaging beachhead and rollback tooling beside the unchanged legacy web product.
why_it_mattered: This created a reversible place to begin the web migration without forcing an unsafe all-at-once cutover.
verified_outcome: The packaging overlay, browser artifacts, legacy replay, and rollback contracts were verified.

title: Complete Phase 5d ZK functional slice
what_changed: Turned the beachhead into a functional ZK CE 10 slice supporting login, role selection, menus, and a read-only business window on Tomcat 10.
why_it_mattered: Business users could reach a real modern UI path while the team proved that it did not accidentally change database state or break SOAP.
verified_outcome: The modern slice matched 11 comparable legacy semantic facts, produced zero writes, and replayed the SOAP corpus during an authenticated session.

title: Phase 5e: cohort routing and modern web session handoff
what_changed: Added fail-closed cohort routing and secure session handoff from the public Tomcat 9 entry point to selected users on Tomcat 10.
why_it_mattered: The application could introduce the modern UI gradually, preserve one public URL, isolate user identities, and fall back safely only where explicitly allowed.
verified_outcome: A 23-row routed matrix covered identities, logout, timeout, container cleanup, re-decision, and SOAP coexistence.

title: Phase 5f: add Jakarta web route contracts, topology, and runtime evidence
what_changed: Converted the remaining non-SOAP route foundations and six web contexts to deterministic Jakarta artifacts with route contracts, rollback, and runtime evidence.
why_it_mattered: The modernization expanded beyond one UI slice to the broader web estate while keeping every route owned and testable.
verified_outcome: The accepted runtime run recorded 129 public-origin observations across 82 legacy routes and six contexts with zero vector failures.

title: Consolidate CI phase gates into two lanes
what_changed: Collapsed duplicated pull-request validation from 12 separate jobs into two stable lanes plus a post-merge regression matrix.
why_it_mattered: This reduced repeated hour-long work and made the modernization feedback loop materially faster without dropping coverage.
verified_outcome: Dry-run task-set proofs showed the consolidated lane preserved the prior database-neutral coverage.

title: Phase 5g-0: reconcile Phase 5f, decompose Phase 5g, add discovery inventories
what_changed: Reconciled Phase 5f, decomposed the remaining UI parity work, and generated discovery inventories before attempting business writes.
why_it_mattered: The team reduced a very large 'finish the UI' goal into independently reviewable increments with explicit oracle-before-modern governance.
verified_outcome: No runtime behavior changed; inventories and the Phase 5g sequencing ADR were accepted.

title: Phase 5g-1a: legacy Business Partner write oracle (database-neutral half)
what_changed: Defined the database-neutral contract, attribution scope, measurement rules, normalization policy, and mutation checks for the first Business Partner write oracle.
why_it_mattered: This prevented the modern implementation from inventing its own expected answer.
verified_outcome: The contract skeleton and fail-closed checks landed without modern runtime code or a parity claim.

title: Trim copilot-instructions to durable conventions, not phase status
what_changed: Trimmed Copilot instructions to durable engineering rules and moved changing phase status back to the modernization plan and evidence documents.
why_it_mattered: This reduced documentation drift and prevented every phase from rewriting the operating instructions.
verified_outcome: A documentation review verified that deleted status facts remained available in authoritative living documents.

title: Phase 5g-1a: legacy Business Partner write capture lane
what_changed: Built the real legacy browser capture lane for Business Partner create, update, two-user conflict, duplicate behavior, and deactivation with a database snapshot after each step.
why_it_mattered: The legacy application finally produced the independently frozen business answer that the modern UI would have to match.
verified_outcome: The accepted oracle used full database restore isolation, per-step effects, self-diff, domain review, and fail-closed scoring.

title: Phase 5g-1a-x: amend and re-freeze the legacy write oracle
what_changed: Amended and re-froze the legacy oracle to cover transport policy, duplicate submission, content-sensitive effects, and modern-versus-legacy browser error classification.
why_it_mattered: The comparison rules were completed before looking at the modern answer, preserving the integrity of the parity test.
verified_outcome: The updated oracle remained legacy-only and added mutation proofs for the newly frozen obligations.

title: Phase 5g-1b: modern Business Partner CRUD parity
what_changed: Implemented modern ZK CE 10 Business Partner create, update, second-editor update, stale-save refusal, duplicate-submit protection, deactivation, workflow attribution, and session cleanup through the public route.
why_it_mattered: This was the first proven business write on the modern UI and the first direct legacy-versus-modern business parity result.
verified_outcome: Two 12-step captures self-diffed, matched the frozen oracle, passed six fail-closed controls, and later passed the complete post-merge regression matrix after follow-up fixes.
